      default void createPreset(SlimefunItem item, java.util.function.Consumer<BlockMenuPreset> setup)
      Deprecated. 
      Leaves the created preset with neither a declared header item nor an explicit title colour, so its GUI title silently falls back to gray unless the (accidental) name-matching heuristic happens to find one. Use createPreset(SlimefunItem, String, int, Consumer) if this menu has a decorative slot repeating the item's own name, or createPreset(SlimefunItem, String, ChatColor, Consumer) to explicitly declare that it does not and choose the title colour instead.

      • createHeaderlessPreset

        default void createHeaderlessPreset(SlimefunItem item,
                                    java.lang.String title,
                                    java.util.function.Consumer<BlockMenuPreset> setup)
        Deprecated. 
        Creates a menu preset for item and declares that it has no header item, so its GUI title takes the colour of the machine's own item name (see BlockMenuPreset.optOutOfHeaderItem()). This is the overload for the common case: a menu with no decorative slot repeating the machine's name, whose title colour should follow the item rather than a hardcoded ChatColor.
        Parameters:
        item - The SlimefunItem this preset belongs to
        title - The preset's inventory title
        setup - Populates the preset's slots

      • createPreset

        default void createPreset(SlimefunItem item,
                          java.lang.String title,
                          int headerItemSlot,
                          java.util.function.Consumer<BlockMenuPreset> setup)
        Deprecated. 
        Creates a menu preset for item and declares headerItemSlot as its header item: the decorative slot whose colour becomes this menu's GUI title colour (see BlockMenuPreset.setHeaderItemSlot(int)).
        Parameters:
        item - The SlimefunItem this preset belongs to
        title - The preset's inventory title
        headerItemSlot - The slot holding this preset's header item, added by setup
        setup - Populates the preset's slots

      • createPreset

        Deprecated.

        Parameters:
        item - The SlimefunItem this preset belongs to
        title - The preset's inventory title
        titleColor - The title colour to use in place of a header item
        setup - Populates the preset's slots
